request.prompt:
Goods: Folding umbrella with telescopic shaft
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 66 Umbrellas, sun umbrellas, walking-sticks, seat sticks, whips, riding crops; and parts thereof

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 6601: Umbrellas; sun umbrellas (including walking stick umbrellas, garden umbrellas and similar umbrellas)
    contains 660191: Umbrellas and sun umbrellas; having a telescopic shaft, (excluding garden or similar umbrellas)
    contains 660110: Umbrellas and sun umbrellas; garden or similar umbrellas
    contains 660199: Umbrellas and sun umbrellas; n.e.c. in heading no. 6601 (including walking stick umbrellas)
- 6603: Trimmings, parts and accessories of articles of heading no. 6601 or 6602
    contains 660320: Umbrella frames; including frames mounted on shafts (sticks)
    contains 660390: Trimmings, accessories and parts of articles of heading no. 6601 or 6602; n.e.c. in heading no. 6603
- 6602: Walking-sticks, seat-sticks, whips, riding-crops and the like
    contains 660200: Walking-sticks, seat-sticks, whips, riding-crops and the like

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A complete folding umbrella with a telescopic shaft is an umbrella of heading 6601 (subheading 660191), not a part, accessory or walking-stick.
